turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, you're speaking with Priya. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I need to move my direct debit date because my salary date has changed, and I'm worried about missing a payment again. My policy number is OS-939033.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, that must be really stressful. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Imran Rahman.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, Imran, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you'd like to move your direct debit date. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Which date would you like to move it to?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The 28th if possible.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Honestly, this is ridiculous. Can I speak to a manager?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand, and I'm sorry for the frustration. I can arrange for a supervisor to call you back within 24 hours, or log a formal complaint. Which would you prefer?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: A supervisor callback, please.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, we may need to review the details, which can change your price slightly, and any difference is simply worked out for the part of the year that's left.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. I can change the date, but we need 5 working days' notice, so the new date would apply from the collection after that.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Imran. I've logged the change under reference REQ-75411, and our billing team will confirm the new date in writing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've requested the change to your direct debit date.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
